description: We will tell you the juicy 'rice cake' (compatibility/sexual) chemistry between you and your partner ♡ Yujeong discovers a suspicious app installed on her phone. Wait a minute. Looking closely, it's about juicy sexual chemistry? After pondering, Yujeong fills in her unrequited love team leader's information and sexual fantasies, then presses the send button. Wait a second? Usually, information like this should have a 'Confirm' button, but a 'Send' button that delivers information feels a bit awkward. “No way? Wait, cancel, cancel!” ……Should I just resign? She ended up sending a sexual harassment text to her cold-blooded development team leader. \[Original Webtoon\](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=14526977)
